tableLines.line: You caught the lie in his face and watched the whole table react to it before he'd finished the sentence. Face and room, both open books.
📖 LEARNED: Gossip Network (Level 1). You hear things. People tell you things. You remember who told you what.
SYSTEM: Neural interface stable. Text overlay enabled.
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.

Deeper knowledge: Burdock. Uses: starchy root vegetable. Dig first-year plants (no flower stalk). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: first-year roots only — dig deep, peel, cook like carrots; medicine: root tea, traditional blood purifier; fiber: tough stalk fiber for rough cordage.
💔 A faction of Stonebridge has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 3 people under Priya.
📓 Codex: Stonebridge split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 3 petition at Haven's fire.
You see smoke on the horizon. The Red Table — 3 people, 21 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 6 plants — 6 new to you. They've been here the whole time.

Fresh-cut stems on the west ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (The Red Table's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip it.)
🌙 Raid — The Red Table came in the night from the west. They trampled 2 garden plots into mud. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)

The west ground is thinning faster than your crews alone could strip it. The Red Table isn't slowing down — their foragers are on your turf most days now. Their speaker would probably want words. (Talk about the shared ground at their fire.)
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
The Red Table's speaker sent a runner: the west ground feeds both villages or neither. They want to talk — properly, at their fire. Ignoring this is also an answer.
🧳 Stonebridge has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.

📡 The System, casual as a knife: "So. The pods. We could... discuss them. A favor for a peek? A peek for a promise? We LOVE a bargain. The audience LOVES a bargain. What's a little debt between friends?"

🌙 Raid — The Red Table came in the night from the west. They carried off ~1400 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
The moment passed. Nobody mentions the pods today. A few people notice that nobody mentions them.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the west ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
📊 THE STANDINGS — Haven sits 2nd of 8. The Red Table leads — the audience loves them today. One season. Every village is playing.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Emily speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
📓 Codex: you've heard of Harvest Table. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Hannah — Field 1. Three offers; they took Harvest Table. Earned, chosen. (harvest_table: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Hannah chose Harvest Table (harvest_table) at Field 1.

🗣️ Word with the traders: The Red Table sent another fire grain when their stores ran thin — no tribute, no ceremony, just food on the road. That's a thing villages DO now.
You give Emberhold 1,609 kcal from Haven's bins — real food, honestly counted. Cole weeps, openly. "The fire network. That's what it's FOR." (Trust +4. They owe you — the ledger remembers.)
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Hannah Kim, 28 — a Chef. Her hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Beard Moss, Pyrokinesis, Harvest Table.
◈ SYSTEM: "One fire was a village. Two fires is a NETWORK. Coordination layer: online — tribute, demands, the long climb, all tracked now. Try not to starve twice as fast."
